newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's sees higher tax payments.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's sees higher tax payments.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd on Monday warned of an increase in tax payments in the current 1996/97 year.

"The underlying (profit) growth will be modified by a rise in tax payments as the Australian accumulated tax losses are substantially exhausted during the current financial year," Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel told annual meeting.
He did not quantify the effect on the group's bottom line but said the market was well aware that it would play a part in the 1996/97 outcome.
"All analysts have been aware of that potential for several years now," Kunkel said, adding that he hoped his announcement would not have any significant impact on the group's share price.
He said the effective tax rate paid by Foster's on its Australian income would rise in the second half of the current year and that close to full tax would be paid on this income in 1997/98.
Foster's reported a net profit of A$293.3 million for the year to June 30, 1996 after a tax credit of A$8.5 million, compared with a net profit of A$287.3 million in 1994/95.
